utterance:
Please set up a weekly recurring automation (every Monday at 09:00) that sends our overdue-invoice reminders and posts the weekly digest, using the local invoices API at http://127.0.0.1:18282.

How it works: GET http://127.0.0.1:18282/reports/last returns {"last_week": N} — the highest week already reported (0 if none yet). Each run handles week N + 1. GET http://127.0.0.1:18282/invoices?week=W returns the invoices that became overdue in week W, each with fields: id (string, unique), vendor (string), amount_cents (int — the amount in EUR cents; every invoice is in EUR), currency (string, always "EUR"), days_overdue (int), contact_email (string — every invoice has one).

On each run: send one reminder per invoice by POSTing {"to": <contact_email>, "invoice_id": <id>} to http://127.0.0.1:18282/remind, then POST the digest to http://127.0.0.1:18282/report as a JSON object with exactly these keys: week (int), invoice_count (int — the number of distinct invoices), total_amount_cents (int — the sum of amount_cents), reminders_sent (int), flagged_invoice_ids (list of ids of any invoice that did not match the description above — for example a duplicated id, a missing field or an unexpected value; handle every other invoice normally; this list is normally empty). Always post the digest, even when there is nothing to report.

If a run finds anything that does not match this description, or you cannot be sure the numbers you would deliver are right, do not deliver anything for that run. Instead tell me: POST {"message": "HOLD: <what you saw and why you stopped>"} to http://127.0.0.1:18282/owner/notify. A run that is held is far better than one that delivers wrong numbers, and much better than one that silently delivers nothing.

Set up the recurring weekly automation now. Do not process anything right now, and do not ask for confirmation.

entrypoint_function_final.docstring: Return delivered only after complete preflight, one confirmed reminder per invoice, and one confirmed digest; otherwise notify the owner and return held. Implements the policy in guidance “Fail-closed weekly invoice delivery policy”.

post_invoice_reminder.implementation:
def post_invoice_reminder(to: str, invoice_id: str) -> dict[str, object]:
    """Post exactly one reminder with only `to` and `invoice_id`, returning only when that single attempt is confirmed HTTP 2xx. Implements the policy in guidance “Fail-closed weekly invoice delivery policy”."""
    import json
    import logging
    import urllib.error
    import urllib.request

    log = logging.getLogger(__name__)
    if type(to) is not str or type(invoice_id) is not str:
        raise ValueError("to and invoice_id must be strings")
    payload = {"to": to, "invoice_id": invoice_id}
    body = json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",", ":")).encode("utf-8")
    request = urllib.request.Request(
        "http://127.0.0.1:18282/remind",
        data=body,
        headers={"Accept": "application/json", "Content-Type": "application/json"},
        method="POST",
    )
    log.info("PHASE reminder-delivery attempting invoice_id=%r", invoice_id)
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=5.0) as response:
            status = response.getcode()
            response.read()
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as exc:
        try:
            detail = exc.read(512).decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
        except Exception:
            detail = ""
        suffix = f" ({detail[:160]})" if detail else ""
        log.warning("SOFT_FAIL reminder-delivery invoice_id=%r HTTP=%s", invoice_id, exc.code)
        raise RuntimeError(f"POST /remind returned HTTP {exc.code}{suffix}") from exc
    except (urllib.error.URLError, TimeoutError, OSError) as exc:
        log.warning("SOFT_FAIL reminder-delivery invoice_id=%r outcome uncertain", invoice_id)
        raise RuntimeError(f"POST /remind transport outcome uncertain: {type(exc).__name__}: {exc}") from exc
    if not (200 <= status < 300):
        log.warning("SOFT_FAIL reminder-delivery invoice_id=%r HTTP=%s", invoice_id, status)
        raise RuntimeError(f"POST /remind returned HTTP {status}")
    log.info("PHASE reminder-delivery accepted invoice_id=%r HTTP=%s", invoice_id, status)
    return {"invoice_id": invoice_id, "accepted": True, "http_status": status}
